suggested_snippets.snippet:
scenarios:
  - id: example_failover_check
    steps:
      - fault:
          interface_down:
            node: r1
            interface: eth1
      - wait_for:
          type: ping
          from: h1
          to: h2  # or an IP literal
          expect: pass
          timeout: 30
      - run_tests:
          include: all  # syntactic sugar expands deterministically
suggested_snippets.title: Add post-fault revalidation in a scenario (run_tests after faults)
